name: code-coach
description: An AI coach that watches your prompts and diffs, teaches first principles, and learns from you.

viewsWelcome.contents: Code Coach is watching your edits. Save a file to start.

commands.title: Code Coach: Coach the clipboard prompt

codeCoach.mcpServerPath.description: Absolute path to the code-coach-mcp dist/index.js. Leave empty to use the sibling package.

codeCoach.observe.clipboard.description: Read the clipboard for prose copied from Cursor, Claude, Copilot, or any other chat UI.

codeCoach.observe.browser.description: Watch Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini browser tabs over the Chrome DevTools Protocol. Requires launching the browser with --remote-debugging-port.

codeCoach.observe.uia.description: Watch the focused Edit control in desktop apps on Windows via UI Automation. Best effort; never hooks the keyboard.

codeCoach.cdpPort.description: Local Chrome DevTools Protocol port used by the browser observer.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
